def equation(t, A, params):
    a = params[0] + params[1]*(1-np.exp(-params[2]*t)) + params[3]*t**params[5]*np.exp(-params[4]*t)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    a = params[0] + params[1]*t/(params[2]+t) + params[3]*t**params[5]*np.exp(-params[4]*t)
    b = params[6]*np.exp(-params[7]*t)
